item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry winter monsoon will continue to bring cold and mainly fine weather to southern China today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week, but it will still be cool in the morning. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will also bring a few rain patches to the coast of southern China.

Date/Month: 25/12 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, becoming east later.
Weather: Fine. Cold in the morning. Very dry during the day.
Temp range: 11 - 17 C
R.H. range: 35 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
